notes.title: 2021.11.24 Draw Music Updata
notes.notes:
Hello, I'm the producer.
 This event reproduced the piano battle in the movie Secret in Draw Music.

 When I watched a movie in middle school and watched the piano, it was one of the scenes that came to mind once, so I wanted to see Miwoo play these songs once as soon as he played the piano.

 I had a hard time because there were only difficult songs, but I'm glad they came out well.

I think it will be more fun if you think of the scene from the movie and enjoy it.

 I didn't think it would take this long...


..
 There's something else to do. 
 I'm still lacking, but I hope you enjoy it.

 The update is Wednesday at 11.


  안녕하세요 제작자 입니다. 
 이번 이벤트는 영화 '비밀'에서 나오는 피아노 배틀을 드로우 뮤직에 재현 시켜 보았습니다.
 제가 중학교때 영화를 정말 재밌게 보고 피아노를 보면 꼭한번은 떠오르는 장면중에 하나여서 미우가 피아노를 치는 순간 꼭 한번은 이 곡들을 연주하는 모습을 보고싶었습니다.
 곡들이 어려운 것들만 있어서 꽤 애를 먹었지만 잘 나온것 같아서 다행으로 생각합니다.
그 영화의 장면을 떠올리면서 즐기시면 더욱 재밌지 않을까 생각합니다.

 이렇게 까지 시간이 걸릴거라고는 생각하지 못했습니다...
 또 할거도 있고....ㅠ
 아직은 부족하지만 재밌게 즐겨주셨으면 좋겠습니다..!!

업데이트는 수요일 11시 쯤에 하겠습니다~

notes.title: 2021.10.25 squid game updata
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41009368/ef8b77db7cf36a55391aabc4c80514eae4fcc281.png[/img]


Hello, I'm the producer.
Finally, I added the squid game to Draw Music!
I'm sorry that it took a lot of time to improve the quality as much as possible.
You can play the squid game by entering the second door of the start map.
Earlier, I would like to explain about the squid game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41009368/9e8eab0a72402f40505c405bdf3ed99d408a09f5.png[/img]

The first game is Mugunghwa Flower Bloomed.
If you come to the point to avoid the tagger's eyes, you win.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41009368/a7beccf1e07f9db534d3d5eee3f04646a797cfb5.png[/img]

The second game is making dalgona.
If you can't move the character and use the keyboard arrow key to pull out the shape of the dalgona, you pass.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41009368/7201e26afdf033b5718472270212712bdaa5263b.png[/img]

The third game is tug-of-war.
Press the space bar to start the game.
If you hit the space bar one after another to win, it'll work out somehow.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41009368/f3a054a6de1ba9031d178d45e10713ef10670707.png[/img]

The fourth game is marbles.
Press the space bar to start the game.
After that, the other party determines the number of beads.
When a black number balloon comes out, 
Determine the number of beads with the upper and lower keys of the keyboard.
And with the left and right keys of the keyboard, determine whether the number of beads of the other party is odd or even.
If you press the space bar, you will choose.
If the number of beads you have reaches 20, you win.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41009368/dd62af294a444702ee56d7a9a46fa4333dcaafa5.png[/img]

The fifth game is a stepping stone.
Use the top and bottom of the keyboard arrow key to select the glass.
If you press the space bar, it jumps and goes toward the selected glass.
If you go to the end, you will pass.

The squid is the sixth game game.
Good luck!



안녕하세요 제작자입니다.
드디어 Draw Music에 오징어 게임을 추가하였습니다!!
최대한 퀄리티를 높이려다 보니까 시간이 많이 걸린점 죄송하게 생각합니다..
오징어 게임은 시작 맵 두번째 문으로 들어가면 하실수 있습니다.
앞서 오징어 게임에 관련된 설명을 드리고자 합니다.

첫번째 게임은 '무궁화 꽃이 피었습니다' 입니다.
술래의 눈을 피해 지점까지 오시면 통과입니다.

두번째 게임은 달고나 뽑기 입니다.
캐릭터를 움직일수 없고 키보드 방향키를 사용하여 달고나의 모양을 뽑으시면 통과입니다.

세번째 게임은 줄다리기 입니다.
스페이스 바를 누르시면 게임이 시작됩니다.
이기기 위해서는 스페이스 바를 연타하시면 어떻게든 될것입니다.

네번째 게임은 구슬치기 입니다.
스페이스 바를 누르시면 게임이 시작됩니다.
그러면 상대방이 걸 구슬의 개수를 정합니다.
검은 숫자 풍선이 나오게 되면 키보드 위쪽,아래쪽 방향키로
본인이 걸 구슬의 개수를 정합니다.
그리고 키보드 왼쪽,오른쪽 방향키로 상대방의 구슬의 개수가 홀수 인지 짝수인지 정합니다.
스페이스 바를 누르시면 선택하게 됩니다.
가지고 있는 구슬의 개수가 20개가 되면 승리합니다.

다섯번째 게임은 징검다리입니다.
키보드 방향키 위쪽, 아래쪽을 사용하여 위쪽 유리와 아래쪽유리를 선택합니다.
스페이스 바를 누르시면 점프하여 선택한 유리 쪽으로 갑니다.
끝까지 가시면 통과입니다.

여섯번째 게임은 오징어 게임입니다.
행운을 빕니다!

notes.title: Draw Music 2021.10.01 update content
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41009368/813fbcb6422fcd0e3ad7a70ed6942294d84d5efc.png[/img]

Archery has finally been added !!

If you want to shoot a bow, you can go into the second door on the map.
If you press the 'space bar' key, you can see MiU loading the bow.

If you score more than 28 points in total, you can get the costume of "Archery Player MiU".

If you hit the heart of the monitor, a small but special event will occur.

I hope users can enjoy it.
Thank you!





Lastly, the next event is...

I'm thinking of celebrating Halloween.

notes.title: Draw Music update 10.01
notes.notes:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41009368/7924d5a0e292c50b5dee0a13aabeb81aa3ac0929.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41009368/fa3f406bc0e709fb453997634a05250cc882f6c4.png[/img][/url]

Hello, I'm the producer of draw music.
I was looking for a way to communicate with users after the launch, but there was a system called the Steam Community. 
I will continue to communicate through the Steam Community in the future.
Please pay a lot of attention. 
This update is scheduled for October 01st.

At the Tokyo Olympics, I applied archery, a popular event in Korea, to the game.
Mi-woo's shooting of archery came out cute watching Korean national team players, so I hope many users enjoy it.

As I was drawing hard, it's already been a month since it was released, so thank you to users who are interested. We will continue to be a draw music that improves.
We are working hard to apply a secret piano battle to the game that cannot be told by the ongoing content.
There are many other things to do, such as how to play other instruments and new bosses, so I'll go draw them. 
I will also correct various errors!
Thank you!!
